events.text: The magistrate has doubled the harvest tax. Farmers are selling their seed grain.

effects.log: He listens, grudgingly, and lowers it a little.
The collectors find less than they hoped.

events.text: The tax collector brings hired thugs to a poor family's door.

ok.log: The thugs leave. The collector remembers your face.

effects.log: The family weeps. (−15 taels)

events.text: You see the collector's ledger. The numbers do not add up.

ok.log: The prefect investigates. The collector is dismissed.

fail.log: The copy is incomplete. Nothing happens.

effects.log: Angry farmers at the magistrate's gate.

events.text: A cart of tax grain lies overturned on the road. Nobody is guarding it.

effects.log: The official thanks you and gives you a sack.

choices.text: Give some to the starving family nearby

effects.log: Tax grain feeds a family. Nobody reports it.

events.text: A widow cannot bring in her harvest alone before the collectors come.

effects.log: Every sheaf in by Friday.
A day of laughter and work.

events.text: Rice prices spike after the tax. Merchants are hoarding.

effects.log: You feed yourself and a neighbour all winter. (−5 taels)
They release some rice.

events.text: The magistrate invites local fighters to a banquet. He wants muscle for collection day.

effects.log: He looks at you coldly. The farmers look at you warmly.
Excellent duck. Uneasy conscience.

events.text: Farmers march on the magistrate's hall with hoes and pitchforks.

choices.text: Keep the peace between both sides

effects.log: Nobody dies. Both sides hate you a little.
The magistrate sees how many there are, and blinks.

events.text: You help with the harvest, mostly by getting in the way.

effects.log: You carry it proudly across the whole field.
Official sparrow chaser. An important job.

events.text: An abandoned imperial granary, doors rotting, still full of old grain.

effects.log: A hungry winter becomes an easier one.
A quiet week of full meals.

events.text: Two brothers come to blows over how to pay the tax.

effects.log: You end up with a black eye and two grateful brothers.

choices.text: Help them work out the numbers

effects.log: There is a way. It takes all evening.

events.text: Tax or no tax, the village holds its harvest feast.

effects.log: You dance badly and happily.
Your stew is the talk of the feast.
